_readme: Floor 1 (Administration) text. Same rules as floor0.json: keep the ids; 'Name[expression]: ' sets the speaker; a line with no name is Donnie thinking. People without portraits (Linda, Ken, Joey, Omar, Tomas...) still get a name plate.

lines: Administration. The Shitshow of Gyaracorp.
Yuvie: Floor one. Administration. Feels like progress, doesn't it?
Donnie[worried]: Is Betty okay?
Adi: She's fine! She beat Irshad at cards. Four times.
Irshad: She cheats.
Adi: She's a child, Irshad.
Irshad: A child who cheats.
Yuvie: Here's the job. Somebody in that building controls the power. The mains, the backup generator, all of it. We want to know who, and where.
Yuvie: Administration keeps the paperwork for everything. Read it.
Donnie[worried]: And the next terminal?
Irshad: Meeting room. Same floor. Good luck getting in.
Yuvie: One more thing. People get funny about janitors near their desks. Push your cart. Nobody looks twice at a man with a mop.
Donnie: ...There'll be a cart in the closet on this floor. Bottom left.
Same gear as downstairs. Cart, mop, bin bags. Nobody looks twice at the cart.
I've got my cart.
A key tagged 'OFFICE A - spare (Grace)'.
A crumpled slip: 'Voltline Electrical - vendor ID V-207. CHASE THE INVOICE.'
Voltline. That's the power people. I'll hang on to this.
Joey's drawer. Three packets of indigestion tablets, a fourth packet, and a key labelled 'Office C (spare)'.
Priya's drawer. Biscuits, sorted by colour. I'm not touching that.
Behind a row of binders called 'BINDERS': a key on a tag. 'OFFICE F'.
A shelf of mugs, board games and a dying cactus. Nothing I'm after. I think.
Top shelf, behind the mugs: a spare key tagged 'MANAGER - L. PARK'. And a single sad orange.
Manager Linda's shelf. Binders, alphabetised and colour-coded. Frightening.
A cubicle. I clean these. I don't linger.
Nothing else in there for me.
Linda and Ken. All day. In the one room with the terminal. Brilliant.
2468 for Office E. The electrician's code. Into the pocket it goes.
Escalated to Floor 2? Why would the HR floor deal with the lights down here?
[worried] Maybe it's just paperwork. There's got to be a switch on this floor somewhere.
Office B: 3172. Joey's office.
Facilities moved to HR and changed their name. And Joey has a... reputation. Ken has a spreadsheet.
People & Facilities. Funny name for a department that runs the lifts.
Admin keeps bouncing the power bill to HR. And Office D is 5590.
[worried] If Admin doesn't pay for the power, who flips the switch? Maybe somebody down here still can.
People & Facilities pays for the power. Cost centre PF-02. I'll keep the printout.
Floor two pays the bill. That doesn't mean floor two holds the switch. Does it?
Electrical plans and the generator manual. Both moved up to HR.
[worried] Everything keeps pointing upstairs. Manager Linda would know for sure.
Manager Linda's spare key is on the shelf in the lounge.
Main power. Backup generator. People & Facilities, Plant room 2B. Floor two.
There's no switch down here. There never was. Admin doesn't control the power at all. Human Resources does.
[worried] And I'm the one who has to tell them that.
[shocked] What's that sound? A whirring. Coming from Manager Linda's shelf.
Something on that shelf is... recording?
Manager Linda's tape recorder, tucked between the binders. Still running. She records every meeting.
The tape's labelled 'MINUTES - JOEY (DO NOT PLAY)'.
...Let me play it.
[shocked] It's Joey. On the loo. For eleven minutes.
[angry] Why is Linda recording a man on the toilet? Gyaracorp's finest have hit a new low just to kill time.
Joey goes to the loo more than anyone alive. The whole floor knows it. Ken has a fucking spreadsheet.
If this came out of the gents' cubicle at full volume... Linda and Ken would want a front-row seat.
[neutral] The end cubicle in the men's washroom it is.
Into the end cubicle, volume all the way up, and... play.
A long, tragic groan echoes off every tile in the room.
Ken: ...Linda. Linda, listen.
Linda: Oh, he's back. That's five today.
Ken: That's not a bathroom break. That's a hostage situation.
Linda: We should... check he's alright.
Ken: Bring your phone. For the minutes.
Linda: For the minutes.
Donnie: ...And the meeting room is empty.
Joey? ...Joey, are you alright in there?
Take your time! We're not... listening.
Shh. I'm timing it.
Personal best, this.
Through the glass: Manager Linda and Ken, deep in the quarterly review. I'm not walking in there.
Clearance for Human Resources. Any time I like, now. Not just after hours.
[worried] Now I just have to tell them what I found.
Yuvie: Well? Who runs the power, Donnie?
[worried] (Tell them the truth?)
Truth: Human Resources. Plant room 2B, on floor two.
Lie: Administration. A riser cupboard, down here.
Donnie[worried]: Human Resources. They call it People & Facilities now. Plant room 2B, floor two.
Yuvie: See? That wasn't hard.
Irshad: HR. Of course it's HR. It's always HR.
Adi: Betty says you're doing a good job. Well. She said 'my dad's going to find you'. Same energy.
Yuvie: Get yourself upstairs, Donnie. We'll call.
Donnie: Administration runs it. There's a riser cupboard down here. That's where the mains are.
Yuvie: ...
Yuvie: A cupboard. On the admin floor.
Donnie[worried]: That's what the records say.
Irshad: The records in Linda Park's office? That you were in twenty minutes ago?
Donnie[shocked]: How do you...
Yuvie: You think you're alone in that building, Donnie? We have someone keeping an eye on you. Closer than you'd like.
Yuvie: So let's try that again some other time. And next time, Betty hears about it first.
Adi: ...He means it. Sorry, Donnie.
Can I help you? That's my desk.
Bins are over there, mate.
Hands off. I've got unsaved work.
Excuse me. Do you mind?
Mop the floor, not my keyboard.
Again? Seriously?
Omar: That's an Accounts machine.
Omar: If my stapler goes missing, I'm calling HR.
Omar: Out. Please. Out.
Tomas: Procurement only, sorry.
Tomas: I'm on a supplier call. Shoo.
Tomas: Every time.
Someone's been taking my stapler.
Invoices don't pay themselves. Unfortunately.
Fourteen quotes for one chair. FOURTEEN.
If it's a delivery, it goes to Reception.
Quarterly review today. Manager Linda's in a mood.
I hear Joey's been in the gents since nine.
My lights keep flickering. Ticket's been open for a month.
Facilities moved to HR, apparently. Nobody told the lights.
Joey: If anyone asks, I'm at my desk.
Joey: Meetings make me nervous. My stomach takes it personally.
Joey: Don't use the end cubicle. Trust me.
Joey's been in here since nine. He says he's 'hot-desking'.
The coffee machine's leaking again.
Manager Linda's doing the quarterly review. Nobody go in there.
Administration: if it's not in triplicate, it didn't happen.
Is that the janitor? Good. Someone's been sick in the lift. Probably Joey.
